business_summary: Toshin Holdings Co.,Ltd engages in the mobile communication related business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Mobile Communications, Real Estate Business, and Resort Business. The company sells mobile communications devices; and undertakes services, such as arranging subscriptions for mobile phone service contracts through stores. It is also involved in the operation and sales of mobile phone shops under the au, SoftBank, and Y!mobile names; development, acquisition, leasing, and management of condominiums and office building; sells real estate; and operates golf courses and driving ranges. In addition, the company engages in the agency sales and outsourcing activities; sale of drinking water; and power generation business. Toshin Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
